CURVE_AXES.doc: The axes a curve kind is drawn on, each with its unit and how a host draws it (docs/curves.md). A curve's values are in these units, so the drawn values can be held equal to the closed form a kernel's controls give.
CURVE_AXES.why: A curve kind names its axes (the remaining-FX wave, openmixer docs/design/specs/2026-10-18-remaining-fx.md section 8, L1): an axis is declared once and every kind drawn on it reads the same unit and scale.

frequency.doc: Frequency, on the points of EQ_CURVE_GRID where the curve is a response.

magnitude.doc: The magnitude of a response at a frequency: 0 dB is unity, a boost positive, a cut negative.

inputLevel.doc: The level a gain computer reads, the static law's input.

outputLevel.doc: The level the static law gives for an input level; the diagonal is no gain change.

inputAmplitude.doc: A memoryless shaper's input sample, linear, -1 to +1 full scale: bipolar, so an even/odd asymmetry shows.

outputAmplitude.doc: The shaper's output sample for an input amplitude, linear, on the same full scale.

delayTime.doc: The time after the dry sound at which a delay's tap or repeat sounds.

decayTime.doc: The time after an impulse over which a reverb's energy decays.

level.doc: A level relative to the dry input: 0 dB is the input's own, a tap or a decay below it negative.

phase.doc: The position within one period of a modulation source, 0 to 1.

modulation.doc: A modulation source's output at a phase, -1 to +1, before the depth scales it.

inputPitch.doc: The pitch played into a pitch effect, semitones from an origin the host picks.

outputPitch.doc: The pitch the effect sounds for an input pitch, semitones on the same origin: an unshifted map is the diagonal.

CURVE_KINDS.doc: The kinds of picture a plugin's panel section draws and a console's card shows, each with the two axes it is drawn on (docs/curves.md). A kernel file and a plugin declaration name a kind by its word; a host keeps only its kind-to-drawing map. Append-only: a kind is never renamed, moved or removed while a reader draws it.
CURVE_KINDS.why: Declared once here and read by the omx-plugins schema and the console's curve registry (remaining-FX spec, section 10 Q2 and FX-6). The first five are the omx-plugins schema's graph kinds as they were; comb-response, modulation-shape and interval-map are the kinds FX-6 adds. modulation-shape is the picture the schema's unused lfo stood for.

eqCurve.doc: An EQ's summed magnitude response over log frequency.

dynamicsCurve.doc: A gate's or a compressor's static law, input level to output level, with the live needle.

transferCurve.doc: A memoryless shaper's transfer, input sample to output sample over full scale.

delayTaps.doc: A delay's taps and repeats, each a line at its time and level.

decayEnvelope.doc: A reverb's decay envelope after an impulse.

combResponse.doc: The wet path's comb or notch response at the current sweep position (chorus, flanger, phaser, doubler).

modulationShape.doc: A modulation source over one period (tremolo, rotary).

intervalMap.doc: A pitch effect's map from the input pitch to the output pitch.
